title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 62
paragraphs: After this hint he turned to Eurybiades and spoke yet more urgently: “If you stay here and, staying, prove yourself a good man, well and good. But if not, you will bring about the ruin of Greece, for on the ships depends all our strength in the war. No — do as I advise. If, however, you will not do this, then we will at once take up our households and sail to Siris in Italy, which has long been ours, and which the oracles say is destined to be colonized by us. And you, left alone and deprived of such allies as we are, will remember my words.”
